descriptions.feature: Add payment terms to invoices (due on receipt, net 15, net 30) and a dueDate function that works out when an invoice is due.
descriptions.bugfix: Fix the bulk discount, which skips line items of exactly 10 units although the rule is 10 units or more.
descriptions.change: Raise the free-shipping threshold from $50.00 to $100.00 of discounted subtotal.
